title: Typed parameter manifest and runtime diagnostic protocol for tool/function calls
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Tool/function calling surface currently produces a wide range of free-form validation failures at runtime. Engineers and integrators find errors hard to act on: messages lack field paths, suggested remediations, and compatibility behavior between older SDKs and new parameter shapes is brittle.

Goal: Define a canonical JSON "parameter manifest" format for function/tool definitions (authoring-time), specify runtime validation behavior (hard vs soft failures, coercion profiles), and create a standardized diagnostic envelope that provides actionable fixes, telemetry signals, and compatibility fallbacks. Deliver an implementation in the runtime, SDK adapters, test harness + migration/rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: A parameter manifest JSON schema DSL is documented and published in the repo (CONTEXT: docs/call-manifest.md link included).
Runtime performs field-level validation and returns a structured diagnostic envelope on validation failures (error code, path, expected type, received sample, remediation hint).
Validation has configurable profiles: strict (P0 customers), default (recommended), permissive/coerce (legacy SDKs).
SDK adapters (Node/Python) expose a helper to pre-validate and present human-friendly errors before issuing RPCs.
Backward-compatibility shim supports 'opt-in' legacy compatibility mode for 3 months per rollout for registered customers.
E2E tests covering 20 common malformed parameter cases are added to the runtime test harness and CI.
Telemetry events are emitted for validation failures with stable metric keys for alerting and dashboards.
design_decisions: Use a compact manifest DSL inspired by JSON Schema but constrained to our call surface to reduce authoring complexity.
Support primitive types (string, number, boolean, object, array) + enums + format hints (iso8601, uuid, email) + 'coercion' enum specifying allowed coercions.
Separate 'authoring schema' (what model & integrator see) from 'runtime contract' (enforced with codes and telemetry).
Errors should be machine-readable (stable 'error_code') and include human hint text for immediate remediation and SDK-level linkable docs.

Implement three validation modes: 'hard' -> reject with error_code VALIDATION_HARD, 'soft' -> accept but attach diagnostics and decrement quality score, 'coerce' -> attempt safe conversions (e.g., "123" -> 123) and surface that conversion in telemetry.
Telemetry uses structured tags: manifest_id, version, route, customer_id (opt-in), validation_mode, error_code.
proposed_schema_snippets: Example coercion profile: "coercion": ["string_to_number", "trim_whitespace", "lowercase"] attached at param-level or manifest-level.

Diagnostic envelope example: {"error_code":"VALIDATION_REQUIRED_MISSING", "path": "/to", "expected": "string(email)", "received": "null", "hint": "Include a valid recipient email in the 'to' field. See docs link." }
runtime_behavior: On call: locate manifest by manifest_id and version; if not found -> return ERROR_MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND (translatable to human message).
Validation order: required presence -> type check -> format check -> enum check -> custom validators (regex/length) -> coercion attempts (if allowed).

If mode==hard: return 400-like error with diagnostic envelope. If mode==soft: attach diagnostics to response metadata and continue. If mode==coerce: attempt conversions, annotate converted fields in response metadata and telemetry.
Runtime caches parsed manifests and precompiled validators to avoid per-request schema parse cost. Kernel responsible for LRU eviction when memory limit hit.
Errors include 'schema_version' and 'manifest_hash' to correlate with regressions in quality monitoring.
error_codes: VALIDATION_REQUIRED_MISSING - Missing required parameter. Example: {"error_code":"VALIDATION_REQUIRED_MISSING", "path":"/payload/recipient", "hint":"Add 'recipient' object with 'email' property." }
VALIDATION_TYPE_MISMATCH - Parameter present but wrong type. Example: expected number but got string. Include sample received value and suggested coercion if allowed.
VALIDATION_FORMAT_INVALID - Format failed (iso8601, uuid, email). Provide regex or example of correct format in hint.
VALIDATION_ENUM_MISMATCH - Value not in allowed set. Suggest nearest allowed value using simple edit distance algorithm when appropriate.
VALIDATION_COERCION_FAILED - Coercion attempted but failed (e.g., 'abc' -> number). Provide original value and fallback instructions.
VALIDATION_HARD_REJECT - Generic hard rejection wrapper referencing specific sub-code and link to docs.
migration_plan: Phase 1 (Docs & tooling): publish manifest DSL and provide manifest linter + vscode snippets. Deadline: 2 weeks.
Phase 2 (SDK helpers): ship Node/Python pre-validation helpers that call local validator to surface errors before network call. Deadline: 4 weeks.
Phase 3 (Runtime opt-in): runtime accepts new manifests; default validation_mode=per-route default (soft). Allow customers to opt-in to 'hard' via console flags.
Phase 4 (Telemetry + Alerts): enable dashboards and a weekly alert for VALIDATION_HARD volume by manifest_id. Use this data to recommend schema relaxations or SDK updates.
Phase 5 (Enforce): after 3-month opt-in window, notify customers with persistent hard failures and offer migration support; enforce stricter defaults only with targeted communication.
rollout_plan: Week 0: Feature branch & RFC review with runtime, SDK, and docs owners.
Week 1-2: Internal dogfood: apply manifests to 3 Redwood internal services and measure false positives.
Week 3: Public beta for a set of early-adopter customers with support from Solutions Eng.
Week 4-8: Iterate based on feedback, add more E2E tests and address edge cases (binary blobs in params, huge arrays).
Week 12: Gradual wider rollout with console UI to toggle validation_mode per route.
testing_plan: Add unit tests for 40 manifest permutations in runtime-validator (corner cases: nested arrays of objects, optional union types).
Add fuzz tests to generate malformed payloads and assert diagnostic envelope shape remains stable.
Integrate with CI gating: any change to manifest parsing must maintain benchmark < 0.5ms median parse time.
